CREATE TABLE "public"."organizationSetting" (
  "address" text DEFAULT 'Main Road, Branch Office, Bangladesh',
  "currencyCode" text DEFAULT 'BDT' NOT NULL,
  "currencySymbol" text DEFAULT '৳' NOT NULL,
  "defaultGraceDays" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "defaultLoanChargeType" text DEFAULT 'PERCENTAGE' NOT NULL,
  "defaultLoanChargeValue" numeric DEFAULT '10'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "defaultLoanFrequency" text DEFAULT 'WEEKLY' NOT NULL,
  "email" text DEFAULT 'info@purbasha.org',
  "establishedYear" text DEFAULT '2018',
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "latePenaltyPercentage" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "logoUrl" text,
  "minGeneralSavingsDeposit" numeric DEFAULT '50'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "minSpecialSavingsDeposit" numeric DEFAULT '100'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "orgName" text DEFAULT 'Purbasha Financial Development Organization' NOT NULL,
  "orgShortName" text DEFAULT 'PFDO',
  "phone" text DEFAULT '+8801700000000',
  "registrationNo" text DEFAULT 'REG-NGO-2024-001',
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "website" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "organizationSetting_defaultLoanChargeType_check_5a68d180" CHECK ("defaultLoanChargeType" IN ('FLAT', 'PERCENTAGE')),
  CONSTRAINT "organizationSetting_defaultLoanFrequency_check_1812a53a" CHECK ("defaultLoanFrequency" IN ('WEEKLY', 'MONTHLY'))
)
